<a id="overview"></a>

## Overview

PRD 002 holds what pij still needs outside the community directory (PRD 001): message identity and queue visibility, spawn and revive ergonomics, daemon affinity, work tree cleanup, verb coverage, wire compatibility, and two live proofs. Each component sits where its PRD row's note found the gap. Workstream 002 orders them.

<a id="decisions"></a>

## Decisions

| id | decision | why | realises |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| d-1 | PRD 002 gets its own blueprint and workstream, not rows in 001's. | PRD 002's non-goal n-1 excludes the community work; separate docs keep 001's coverage and PMs about the community. | — |
| d-2 | The live proofs (req-01, req-14) are evidence from real sessions, not CI tests. | CI has no Claude, Codex or Copilot session to receive a message; a stand-in socket or sender-side test is what the rows say is not enough. | [req-01](../prds/002-pij-base.dd.md#requirements), [req-14](../prds/002-pij-base.dd.md#requirements) |

<a id="costs"></a>

## Costs

| id | what | rate | scaling | component |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| k-1 | Daemon discovery when a seat or message is not found | One listing per lookup miss or per listing command; no background probe. | Grows with the number of daemons on the machine, not with seats or time. | [c-daemon-discovery](#components) |
| k-2 | Queued-send notice | At most two notices per queued message (delivered or given up), event-driven from the existing delivery outcome; no poll. | Grows with queued messages, not with seats or time. | [c-sender-notice](#components) |
